profile.headline: Computer Engineer at Dynetics, Inc.
profile.summary: Secret Clearance. I currently work on real time embedded systems at Dynetics.

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description: Currently my work is focused on FPGA firmware development in VHDL and RTOS development in C programming.

positions.title: IT Student Assistant
positions.description: Student worker at the IT help desk that services the college of Engineering and Sciences. We make house calls to professors or other office employees, manage all lab computers and software for research and classes, and are responsible to resolve issues without supervision. Our services can be anything from a printer jam to software installs to needing to make a hardware replacement for both laptops and desktops.

positions.title: Co-Op Engineer
positions.description:
3 co-op rotations for a total of 1 year of work experience.

I worked in the R&D department at Itron's West Union location. My primary projects were automating tests using LabVIEW and C#. These were to run on a power supply board and to create a harmonics test bench for a future meter iteration. I gained experience with electrical equipment and some firmware for the meters. I assisted with quality testing for the development of new revisions of register boards for electric meters.
